title: Technology Sector Update for 01/18/2019: WDC,ZAYO,ANET,CASA - Nasdaq.com
text:

Technology stocks rode large gains higher this afternoon, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 adding more than 1.4% while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising more than 2.1%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) RBC Capital Cuts Western Digital ( WDC ) jumped nearly 7% on Friday, even after RBC Capital Markets lowered its price target for the data storage device company by $8 to $40 a share while maintaining a sector perform rating.
In other sector news:
(+) Zayo Group Holdings ( ZAYO ) rose almost 8% at one point on Friday following media reports a private equity consortium was interested in buying the networking equipment company. Zayo also said it was selected to provide multiple point-to-point dark fiber and long-haul wavelength connections for an unnamed global media company.
(+) Arista Networks ( ANET ) received a boost during Friday trading, climbing almost 5%, after Nomura upgraded the cloud networking company to buy with a $260 price target from a neutral call previously.
(-) Casa Systems ( CASA ) dropped 22% after the broadband products company issued preliminary Q4 results trailing Wall Street expectations. It also was downgraded by a few firms on Friday.
